claims: Alexia Jayy won Season 29 of The Voice on April 14, 2026.
Alexia Jayy is a 31-year-old R&B singer from Alabama.
Alexia Jayy was part of Team Adam (Levine).
Alexia Jayy secured the victory in the "Battle of the Champions" finale.
Alexia Jayy's win marked coach Adam Levine’s fourth win in the show's history.
Alexia Jayy performed Aretha Franklin's "I Never Loved a Man (The Way I Love You)" and other soul-influenced songs to win the title.
Jayy is the first Black woman to win The Voice, according to Alabama.com.
The finale was a "Battle of the Champions" featuring returning coaches Adam Levine, Kelly Clarkson, and John Legend.
